about: Obsession's single source of pricing. Primitives are what we pay (wholesale). Pieces are the one price list: what we sell one by one. A paid plan's monthly fee covers a set amount of usage at list rates (Developer $20 for $20, Startup $99 for $111, Scale $499 for $588); past it, list rates as you go; Free keeps fixed allowances; model tokens are pieces too, at the model's own price plus 30% (founders, 22 Nov 2026). A blueprint run counts toward that covered usage at the piece rates like any piece: each blueprint states what one run uses, and each of its 4 scenarios (the free run, then a small, medium and large typical month) states how many units and how often. engine.js turns these into what a typical month costs the buyer (usage x piece rates, model tokens included) and what it costs us. No price is typed anywhere in this file except the retail piece prices and the plan prices, which are set by the founders and checked against wholesale here.

billing.about: How the paid plans bill (founders, 22 Nov 2026). There is one price list, the pieces at list rates, on every plan. A paid plan's monthly fee covers a set amount of usage at those list rates: Developer $20 covers $20, Startup $99 covers $111, Scale $499 covers $588. Past the covered amount, usage is billed at list rates, pay as you go up to any monthly spend cap the buyer sets. Model tokens are pieces like any other: input, cached input and output per million tokens at the model's own price plus 30%, counted toward what a plan covers, or free with the buyer's own key. There is no credit and no discount: plans differ by how much usage their fee covers and by features, never by fixed amounts of each piece.
billing.unit: US dollars of usage at list rates, never points or abstract credits. Every piece rate stays in dollars per unit.
billing.rolloverRule: Covered usage resets at the start of each month and does not roll over.
billing.blueprints: A blueprint run counts toward the plan's covered usage at list rates, then pay as you go, like any piece, its model tokens included (founders, 22 Nov 2026): each blueprint stores the tokens its last measured run used and prices them at the token rates, assuming the measured cache share. There is one price list, the pieces: a blueprint has no prices or margins of its own. Each blueprint page shows what a typical month of it costs at list rates, worked out from what each run uses. The first run of every blueprint is free.

value.about: What each paid plan's fee covers at list rates (founders, 22 Nov 2026): Developer $20 for $20, Startup $99 for $111, Scale $499 for $588, Enterprise lower again by contract. Inside the covered amount a unit earns us its list rate x fee / covers (Startup 0.89, Scale 0.85); past it, list rates. These are the same sums as the old credits ($100 at 10% off is $111; $500 at 15% off is $588), said as what the plan covers.
value.floorRule: Every piece with a set list price keeps at least a 25% margin on Scale's covered usage (its list rate x 499 / 588) over what a unit costs us at the margin (wholesale). The browser plan fee is fixed overhead, like the server bill, and never counts toward the floor (founders, 22 Nov 2026): the browser is $0.10 an hour at list, about $0.085 inside Scale's covered usage over $0.06 (29%), and the stealth browser $0.85, about $0.72 over $0.48 (34%). The US texting registration counts toward covered usage at its fixed list prices and keeps its own margin there ($17 a month earns about $14.43 on Scale over at most $10; the $25 filing about $21.22 over $19.50). List prices were raised on 22 Nov 2026 to meet the floor, rounded to clean figures.

billing.marginRule: Plan margins are judged on every piece, model tokens included. Pieces priced at cost plus a markup (model tokens, a persona's own voice) keep their markup at list and stay above cost inside every plan's covered usage; the 25% floor applies to the other pieces.
billing.registration: The US carriers' texting registration is at fixed list prices, the same on every plan (founders, 22 Nov 2026): $25 once to file each campaign and $17 a month for each active campaign, both counted toward the plan's covered usage at those prices, then pay as you go. No plan includes a campaign, and we bear none of the cost. It costs us $19.50 once and $1.50 to $10 a month a campaign.

typicalMonth.about: A mid-size buyer's month, in each piece's own unit: 50 personas with an inbox, 20 numbers, 1 US texting campaign, browsers, a sandbox, the event log and our model. It is the worked example bill in check.mjs, and, without model tokens (billing.outside), each plan's typical mix (scaled to fill the plan's covered usage for its typical margin). Model tokens count in millions: 400M input, 55% of it cached, and 4M output.

estimates.about: How a blueprint's typical month is worked out and said (founders, 22 Nov 2026): what each run uses, counted in pieces, x each piece's list rate, model tokens and a persona's own voice included. No margin, no plan rates. Shown as "about $N a month".
estimates.rule: Round to the nearest dollar; under $10, to the nearest 50 cents, never below 50 cents.
